outcome: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia)
cohort: The study included 1,462 people with two singleton pregnancies between 2015 and 2018 at a single academic center in urban Milwaukee.
finding: Interpregnancy intervals less than 6 months were associated with higher odds of preterm birth, while intervals of 12 to 17 months were associated with higher odds of congenital anomalies.
